shortcuts.name: Send to TV
shortcuts.description: Share a note here to add it to your list on the TV
shortcuts.codeOnPrepare: if (!getVariable('hometv_url') || !getVariable('hometv_auth') || !getVariable('hometv_list')) { showToast('Pair this phone first: scan the QR in the TV\'s Launcher settings, Phone notes, then tap Pair this phone.'); abort(); }
shortcuts.codeOnSuccess: var m = ''; try { m = JSON.parse(response.body).message; } catch (e) {} showToast(m || 'Sent to the TV.');
shortcuts.codeOnFailure: var m = ''; try { m = JSON.parse(response.body).message; } catch (e) {} showToast(m || 'Could not reach the TV: is this phone on the home Wi-Fi?');

shortcuts.name: Pair with TV
shortcuts.description: Opened from the TV's setup page: keeps the TV's address, code and your list on this phone
shortcuts.codeOnPrepare: var u = getVariable('hometv_url'), a = getVariable('hometv_auth'), l = getVariable('hometv_list'); if (!u || !a || !l) { showToast('Open Pair this phone on the TV\'s setup page.'); abort(); } setVariable('hometv_url', u); setVariable('hometv_auth', a); try { l = decodeURIComponent(l); } catch (e) {} setVariable('hometv_list', l); showToast('Paired: notes you share to Send to TV go to ' + l + '\'s list.');
